title: Run all existing native oracle suites with guarded discovery
scope: One native runner for existing ignored core/IO suites, retaining their independent adapters, inputs and evidence. Not the general paired harness.
acceptance: All eleven required entrypoints discovered; missing/duplicate or empty discovery fails. All ignored core/IO suites run and failures propagate.
open_items: General P36 independent adapter protocol, browser-Wasm execution, accepted-unit exact-base ratchet and G0/P05 remain open.
Discovery guard freezes entrypoint names, not all case identities; individual suites enforce their own case/value contracts.
